# CASE py_inorder_comment_triple_quote expect=pass
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        await step(
            item,  # don't use """ or f"{await x}" here
        )


# CASE py_mwc_gather_comment_brace expect=pass
import asyncio


async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        await asyncio.gather(
            *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])  # it's {fine}
        )


# CASE py_inorder_tstring_dup expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        log(await step(item), t"{await step(item)}")


# CASE py_inorder_fstring_dup_control expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        log(await step(item), f"{await step(item)}")
